During the enforcement period, entry into, transiting, mooring, laying-up, or anchoring within the safety zone is prohibited unless authorized by the Captain of the Port Lake Michigan or a designated on-scene representative.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20900","title":"Safety Zone; Brandon Road Lock and Dam to Lake Michigan Including Des Plaines River, Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal, Chicago River, and Calumet-Saganashkee Channel, Chicago, IL","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20900/safety-zone-brandon-road-lock-and-dam-to-lake-michigan-including-des-plaines-river-chicago-sanitary","summary":"The Coast Guard will enforce a safety zone on the South Branch of the Chicago River between mile markers 325.5 and 325.4 for the demolition of the Lake Street Bridge for the Chicago Department of Transportation bridge repair. During the enforcement period, entry into, transiting, mooring, laying-up, or anchoring within the safety zone is prohibited unless authorized by the Captain of the Port Lake Michigan or a designated on-scene representative.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20895","title":"Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20895/petition-for-reconsideration-of-action-in-rulemaking-proceeding","summary":"Petition for Reconsideration (Petition) has been filed in the Commission's proceeding by Thomas Goode on behalf of the Alliance for Telecommunications Industry Solutions.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20892","title":"Notice of Availability of the Proposed Notice of Sale for the Cook Inlet Outer Continental Shelf Oil and Gas One Big Beautiful Bill Act Lease Sale 2","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20892/notice-of-availability-of-the-proposed-notice-of-sale-for-the-cook-inlet-outer-continental-shelf-oil","summary":"The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) announces the availability of the Proposed Notice of Sale (NOS) for the Cook Inlet Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) Oil and Gas One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) Lease Sale 2 (Lease Sale BBC2). BOEM is publishing this notice pursuant to its regulatory authority under 30 CFR part 556. Pursuant to Section 19 of the OCS Lands Act, the Secretary of the Interior provides the Governors of affected States and the executive of any affected local government with the opportunity to review and comment on the Proposed NOS. The Proposed NOS describes the proposed size, timing, and location of the sale, including lease stipulations, terms and conditions, minimum bids, royalty rates, and rental rates, which are required by Section 50102 of the OBBBA for this sale.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20890","title":"Project-Level Predecisional Administrative Review Process","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20890/project-level-predecisional-administrative-review-process","summary":"The U.S. Department of Agriculture is issuing a final rule amending its Project-Level Predecisional Administrative Review Process regulations. These regulations establish the process by which the public may file objections seeking administrative review of proposed projects and activities implementing land management plans on national forests and grasslands. The Department is amending these regulations to consolidate and streamline processes, increase efficiency, and better align with the Agency's statutory obligations and recent rescissions and revisions to National Environmental Policy Act regulations.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20889","title":"Fees for Services Performed in Connection With Licensing and Related Services-2026 Update","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20889/fees-for-services-performed-in-connection-with-licensing-and-related-services-2026-update","summary":"The Board updates for 2026 the fees that the public must pay to file certain cases and pleadings with the Board. Pursuant to this update, 87 of the Board's 135 fees will increase and 48 fees will remain at their current levels.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20888","title":"Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20888/regulation-crypto-asset-transactions-and-regulation-crypto-asset-markets","summary":"The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (\"Commission\" or \"CFTC\") is issuing an advanced notice of proposed rulemaking regarding section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act (\"CEA\" or \"Act\") to provide notice and seek public comment on its intent to develop and establish fit-for-purpose rules implementing section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Act with respect to transactions and markets in crypto assets.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20887","title":"Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20887/formations-of-acquisitions-by-and-mergers-of-bank-holding-companies","summary":"","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20886","title":"Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20886/change-in-bank-control-notices-acquisitions-of-shares-of-a-bank-or-bank-holding-company","summary":"","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20885","title":"Airworthiness Directives; Airbus Helicopters","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20885/airworthiness-directives-airbus-helicopters","summary":"The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for all Airbus Helicopters Model H160-B helicopters. This proposed AD was prompted by a report of the inability to operate the jettisoning function of a window due to a blocked jettisoning mechanism. This proposed AD would require removing the jettisonable windows, cleaning the ropes of the jettisonable windows, and performing an operational test of the windows jettison systems. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20884","title":"Advance Traveler Information for Rail","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20884/advance-traveler-information-for-rail","summary":"U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is proposing to require rail carriers to transmit advance electronic traveler information to CBP for any individual (crew and passengers) who is arriving in or departing from the United States on board a train. The rail carrier also would be required to transmit an advance notice of arrival or departure, as applicable, for the train. This rule would enhance security while facilitating legitimate international travel on board trains.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20883","title":"Badger Mountain Hydro, LLC; Comment Request; Extension","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20880/commission-information-collection-activities-ferc-725b-comment-request-extension","summary":"In compliance with the requirements of the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, 44 U.S.C. 3506(c)(2)(A), the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission or FERC) is soliciting public comment on the currently approved information collection, FERC-725B (1902-0248), Mandatory Reliability Standards, Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP)--Update to CIP-015. This update changes the CIP-015-1 standard to CIP-015-2 which reflects the changes implemented through Order RD26-6- 000 issued on August 10, 2026.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20878","title":"Railroad Revenue Adequacy-2025 Determination","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20878/railroad-revenue-adequacy-2025-determination","summary":"On October 8, 2026, the Board served a decision announcing the 2025 revenue adequacy determinations for the nation's Class I railroads. Four Class I railroads (BNSF Railway Company, CSX Transportation, Inc., Norfolk Southern Combined Railroad Subsidiaries, and Union Pacific Railroad Company) were found to be revenue adequate.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-20877","title":"Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act Provisions; Atlantic Coastal Fisheries Cooperative Management Act Provisions; General Provisions for Domestic Fisheries; Application for Exempted Fishing Permits","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/13/2026-20877/magnuson-stevens-fishery-conservation-and-management-act-provisions-atlantic-coastal-fisheries","summary":"The Assistant Regional Administrator for Sustainable Fisheries, Greater Atlantic Region (GARFO), NMFS, has made a preliminary determination that an Exempted Fishing Permit (EFP) application contains all of the required information and warrants further consideration. The EFP would allow federally permitted fishing vessels to fish outside fishery regulations in support of exempted fishing activities proposed by the Massachusetts Division of Marine Fisheries (MA DMF). Regulations under the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act require publication of this notification to provide interested parties the opportunity to comment on applications for proposed EFPs.","publishedAt":"2026-10-13","source":"Federal Register"}]}
